key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02A8
name: forward_call_via_pointer
description: Forwards the global argument to a routine reached through an indirect pointer kept in the data area, then returns nothing. It is a single-call trampoline.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02AE
name: forward_call_return_code
description: Calls the same indirect pointer with the global argument and then returns the constant 20 as its result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02B4
name: tokenise_command_line
description: Splits a text line into whitespace-separated words, treating double-quoted runs as single words and star sequences as escapes for escape, newline or a literal character. It stores the words in a newly allocated pointer array, then calls each handler in a stored linked list.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02BC
name: run_probe_and_flag_failure
description: Runs an initial called routine, then a probe routine on a context sub-block and a global buffer. A zero probe result sets the failure flag byte in the context, while a non-zero result runs two more called routines and the function returns true.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:02FA
name: mark_context_failed
description: Sets the failure flag byte in the context block to one and returns zero. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data area, so it works as an error handler.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:0818
name: write_block_update_total
description: Returns one at once when the failure flag is clear and a status routine returns non-zero. Otherwise it writes the buffer through a called routine and adds the requested length to the running total in the context when every byte was written, returning zero; a short write returns two.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:0836
name: verify_write_adds_total
description: Calls a write routine on the context block and compares its result with the length held in a data register. On a full match it adds that length to the running total and returns zero; otherwise it returns two.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:084E
name: add_count_to_total
description: Adds the length in a data register to the running total stored in the context block and returns zero. It is a one-line accumulator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:142E
name: free_linked_node_list
description: Walks the singly linked list whose head sits in the context block, calling a called routine on each node with the fixed size 118. Afterwards it clears the head pointer and node count and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:144C
name: reset_node_list_head
description: Sets the list head pointer and the node count in the context block to zero, emptying the list without visiting its nodes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:162C
name: pack_context_flags_byte
description: Packs eight flag bytes from the context block into one output byte, one flag per bit, and stores it through the caller's pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:51C8
name: parse_command_switches
description: Parses the argument words of the command, each a dash-prefixed switch letter with an optional attached value. A large switch stores flags and values in the context and clamps numeric settings to fixed minimum and maximum bounds, and an unrecognised letter reports an error and returns one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5B7C
name: next_option_value
description: Walks the argument vector past words that do not start with a dash, records the index of the first option seen, and returns the text attached after the switch letter, or an empty string when nothing is attached. It returns null once the arguments run out.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5B82
name: next_option_value
description: Walks the argument vector past words that do not start with a dash, records the index of the first option seen, and returns the text attached after the switch letter, or an empty string when nothing is attached. It returns null once the arguments run out.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5C24
name: next_positional_argument
description: Returns the next argument that is not a dash-prefixed switch, skipping switches on the way. After a double-dash argument, dash-prefixed words are also returned as arguments, and null is returned when the list is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5C8E
name: parse_slash_date_fields
description: Parses a slash-separated year, month and day string. The year must be from 1970 to 2099, the month from 1 to 12 and the day from 1 to 31, and the year's low byte is stored offset by the letter N with the month and day in the output buffer; it returns one when any field is out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5CBA
name: store_year_parse_month_day
description: Fragment of the date parser entered after the year is known: it stores the year byte, then parses the month and day fields after the slash separators with the same range checks of 12 and 31. It returns zero on success and one on a bad field.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5CD2
name: parse_month_day_fields
description: Parses the month and then the day from the remaining string, after an optional leading slash, with ranges one to 12 and one to 31. The values go to the output at offsets two and one, and the routine returns zero when both are valid.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5CE4
name: parse_month_then_day
description: Parses a month number from the start of the remaining string, then skips to the next slash and parses a day number, checking the ranges one to 12 and one to 31. It returns zero when both are valid.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D00
name: parse_day_after_slash
description: Skips to the character after the first slash, then parses a day number from one to 31 into the output. It returns zero for a valid day and one otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D0E
name: parse_day_skip_slash
description: Skips an optional leading slash, then parses a day number that must be from one to 31 into the output at offset one. It returns zero for a valid day and one when the string is empty or the value is out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D20
name: parse_day_number_checked
description: Parses a day number from the current position, requiring a value from one to 31, and stores it in the output at offset one. It returns zero on success and one otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D3C
name: stub_return_zero
description: A stub that only returns zero, called from five places as a no-op default.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5D44
name: initialise_default_option_block
description: Sets the option defaults in the context block, including flags, numeric limits and a buffer size chosen from a mode byte, and copies a fixed default string into a context buffer. It also clears the pause flag before returning.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5E10
name: update_pause_flags_counter
description: Decrements a counter in the context to update the pause flag and related status bytes. When the pause flag is set it calls the task-priority library routines and runs a called routine that shows the paused prompt.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5E8C
name: check_char_class_table
description: Looks up the first byte of the string in a character-class table and loops while one class bit is set, then calls a called routine. The return value comes from a variable this fragment never assigns, so the result is unreliable as decoded.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5E92
name: notify_handler_list_then_call
description: Walks the linked list of handler function pointers stored in the context, calling each one, then passes its argument to a finishing called routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5E98
name: run_mode_setup_sequence
description: Runs three setup called routines, then when the mode byte is below two it passes a fixed string and the value 100 to a called routine. It stores a default name pointer in the context, calls a processing called routine with its parameters, and calls a follow-up called routine only when that result is one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:5FEC
name: detect_runtime_environment
description: Finds the current task and checks a 16-bit version field: below 37 it opens the arp.library and records the library pointer, otherwise it sets a bit on the task flag word. It then maps status bits to a mode value from zero to four and clears two status bytes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:607A
name: wrap_helper_call
description: Calls a single called routine with no arguments and returns, acting as a thin wrapper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:6080
name: save_field_set_minus_one
description: Saves a 32-bit field from a structure referenced by the context into the context, overwrites that field with all ones, and sets a flag byte to one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:70A8
name: format_temp_file_name
description: Formats a temporary file name from a fixed pattern containing the text LZXCmprTemp and a per-slot value, writing it into the slot's entry of a table whose records are 92 bytes apart.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7B74
name: clear_buffer_open_file
description: Clears a 144-byte buffer, then matches the mode string against fixed strings to choose an open code. An unrecognised mode prints an error and exits with code 40, and otherwise the file is opened through the system open calls.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7BAC
name: open_file_by_mode
description: Matches the mode string against fixed strings to choose an open code, reporting an unrecognised mode and exiting with code 40. It then opens the file through the system open calls and stores the handle through the output pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7BC6
name: open_file_checked_mode
description: Accepts one of two fixed mode strings to select an open code, and reports any other mode and exits with code 40. It then opens the file through the system open calls.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7BE0
name: open_file_single_mode
description: Accepts a single fixed mode string to select an open code, and reports any other mode and exits with code 40. It then opens the file through the system open calls.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7BFA
name: report_unknown_open_mode
description: Reports an unknown file open mode and exits with code 40, then falls through to the open path with the mode code left unset.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C34
name: try_open_store_handle
description: Calls a system routine through the library base and stores a non-zero handle into the output pointer. When the handle is zero it calls a second system routine and returns true, which means the open failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C4A
name: store_value_return_zero
description: Stores the 32-bit value passed in a data register through the output pointer and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C50
name: try_dos_open_handle
description: Calls the dos.Open library routine and stores a non-zero handle through the output pointer. It returns true when the handle is zero, meaning the open failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C66
name: store_value_return_zero
description: Stores the 32-bit value passed in a data register through the output pointer and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C70
name: close_handle_or_report
description: Closes the file handle when it is non-zero through the dos.Close library routine, otherwise it reports that the handle was already closed. It then clears a 144-byte buffer and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7C88
name: close_and_clear_buffer
description: Calls the dos.Close library routine, then clears a 144-byte buffer and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7CAA
name: read_bytes_if_positive
description: Returns zero when the requested byte count is below one, otherwise it calls the dos.Read library routine and returns its result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7D28
name: wrap_dos_write
description: Calls the dos.Write library routine with the arguments already in place, acting as a thin wrapper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:7FB0
name: fetch_standard_io_handles
description: Stores the dos.Input handle in the context, and stores the dos.Output handle too unless a flag byte is set, in which case the output handle is cleared to zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:809E
name: call_dos_routine_if_enabled
description: When the flag byte in the context is clear, it calls a dos library routine at the library offset of minus 792; otherwise it returns without doing anything.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:80C0
name: report_user_abort
description: Runs a cleanup routine, then passes the user-abort message text to a print called routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:80D0
name: report_code_five_set_flag
description: When a status flag is clear, it reports the code 5 through a called routine and sets a second flag to one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:80EC
name: report_code_four_clear_flag
description: When a status flag is clear, it reports the code 4 through a called routine and clears a second flag to zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8106
name: write_when_output_open
description: When a flag byte is clear and the stored output handle is non-zero, it calls the dos.Write library routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8134
name: write_bytes_in_chunks
description: When a flag is clear and the output handle is set, it writes the requested byte count in chunks of at most 1024 through dos.Write, checking a status routine after each chunk. It returns 11 when the called routine signals a stop and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8158
name: write_remaining_in_chunks
description: Writes the remaining byte count in chunks of at most 1024 through dos.Write, checking a status routine between chunks. It returns 11 when the called routine signals a stop and zero when all bytes are written.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8164
name: write_1024_byte_chunks
description: Writes data in fixed chunks of 1024 bytes through dos.Write, checking a status routine between chunks. It returns 11 when the called routine signals a stop and zero when the count is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:818C
name: format_and_write_message
description: When a flag is clear and the output handle is set, it formats a message into a context buffer using the caller's arguments, then measures the text and writes it through dos.Write.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:81D0
name: call_dos_routine_if_enabled
description: Calls a dos library routine at a fixed offset when a flag byte is clear, and does nothing otherwise; this copy uses the offset minus 426.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:81EE
name: call_dos_routine_if_enabled
description: Calls a dos library routine at a fixed offset when a flag byte is clear, and does nothing otherwise; this copy uses the offset minus 426.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:820C
name: wrap_dos_read_call
description: Surrounds a dos.Read library call with called routine calls, adding a further pair when a flag byte is set. It returns a byte from a local variable this routine never assigns, so the result is unreliable as decoded.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8250
name: read_key_matching_set
description: Repeatedly reads a key through a called routine and echoes it with a formatted print, folding lower case letters to upper case via a character-class table. It returns the key once it matches one of the characters in the given string.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8296
name: read_key_until_match
description: A gap fragment of the key-matching loop: it reads a key, folds case through a character-class table and repeats until the key matches the character at the given pointer, then returns it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:82B2
name: read_key_until_match
description: A gap fragment of the key-matching loop: it reads a key, folds case through a character-class table and repeats until the key matches the next character of the given string, then returns it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:82B6
name: stub_return_nothing
description: An empty routine that only returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:82BC
name: wrap_call_with_messages
description: Passes a fixed text to a called routine, calls a called routine with no arguments, then passes the same fixed text to the called routine again.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:82D4
name: compute_intuition_size_ratio
description: Opens intuition.library and, under Forbid and Permit, reads the window dimension fields and divides the available size by a stored unit value, clamping the quotient to at least 8. It returns 23 when the library or a required structure is missing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:838C
name: check_string_for_wildcards
description: Scans the string for any of eight special characters copied from a fixed table, several of them AmigaDOS pattern symbols. It returns one on the first match and zero at the end of the string.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:83C2
name: check_string_for_wildcards
description: A gap fragment of the same character scan: it walks the string and returns one on the first character found in the eight-character table, or zero at the end of the string.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:83C6
name: check_string_for_wildcards
description: A gap fragment of the same character scan: it walks the string and returns one on the first character found in the eight-character table, or zero at the end of the string.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:83CA
name: stub_return_zero
description: A stub that only returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8AC2
name: wrap_exec_free_memory
description: Calls the exec.FreeMem library routine with the arguments already in place and returns, acting as a thin wrapper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:8AE0

name: update_crc32_checksum
description: Updates a running CRC-32 over a buffer using a 256-entry table in the context, and stores the running value in the context. It returns the bitwise complement of the updated value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:D63E
name: update_checksum_in_chunks
description: If the buffer is null it resets the checksum state in the context to all ones and returns zero. Otherwise it passes the data to a called routine in pieces of at most 1048576 bytes and returns the result of the final piece.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:D65A
name: feed_checksum_in_chunks
description: Passes data to a called routine in pieces of at most 1048576 bytes and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:D66C
name: feed_checksum_chunks_tail
description: A gap fragment of the chunked called routine loop: it passes a full 1048576-byte chunk to a called routine, then passes the remainder to a second called routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E420
name: build_huffman_decode_table
description: Counts how many symbols use each code length, derives the first code of each length and fills the decode table from those codes. The pseudo-code is truncated in the bundle, so the later fill stages are described only from their visible start.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E6C0
name: run_init_function_list
description: Walks a null-terminated table of function pointers in the context, calling each entry while a flag is set or the last result is zero. It sets the flag when the table ends and returns the last result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E6C6
name: run_init_function_list
description: Walks a null-terminated table of function pointers in the context, calling each entry while a flag is set or the last result is zero. It sets the flag when the table ends and returns the last result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E6F4
name: call_indirect_handler_return_constant
description: Calls the handler through a pointer stored in a global variable, passing the address of a global variable, and returns the constant 20.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E716
name: invoke_global_callback
description: Calls the function pointer stored in a global table, passing the address of a global variable, and then returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E7D8
name: compare_strings_ignoring_case
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings one character at a time after converting lowercase letters to uppercase. It returns the difference at the first mismatch, or zero when the strings are equal.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E81C
name: parse_signed_integer
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and then the decimal digits of an integer from the string, storing the signed value through the output pointer. It returns the number of characters consumed from the start of the string.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E868
name: lowercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each uppercase letter in the zero-terminated string to lower case in place using the character-class table, and returns the start pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E874
name: lowercase_string_in_place
description: A gap fragment of the same in-place lower-case conversion, without a return of the start pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E88E
name: lowercase_string_tail
description: A gap fragment of the case-folding copy: it walks the string from the given pointer, writing each character in lower case until the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8A0
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each lowercase letter in the zero-terminated string to upper case in place using the character-class table, and returns the start pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8AC
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: A gap fragment of the same in-place upper-case conversion, without a return of the start pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8C6
name: uppercase_string_tail
description: A gap fragment of the case-folding copy: it walks the string from the given pointer, writing each character in upper case until the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8D8
name: free_pending_node_list
description: Walks a linked list of pending nodes in the context, freeing each node with the exec.FreeMem library routine. When the last node is freed and a 16-bit field is above 35 it also calls an exec library routine at offset minus 732.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E8DE
name: free_pending_node_list
description: Walks a linked list of pending nodes in the context, freeing each node with the exec.FreeMem library routine. When the last node is freed and a 16-bit field is above 35 it also calls an exec library routine at offset minus 732.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E948
name: shutdown_and_return_value
description: Saves the value passed in into the frame, runs an optional callback, then calls a sequence of library routines to release resources before returning the saved value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:E950
name: tokenise_command_line
description: Splits a text line into whitespace-separated words, treating double-quoted runs as single words and star sequences as escapes for escape, newline or a literal character. It stores the words in a newly allocated pointer array, then calls each handler in a stored linked list.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EAB4
name: free_tokenised_args_buffer
description: When the word count and the word array pointer are both non-zero, it frees the array with the exec.FreeMem library routine and returns that call's result. Otherwise it returns the word count unchanged.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EAD8
name: compare_strings_bounded
description: Compares up to the given number of characters of two strings, returning minus one, one or zero for less, greater or equal at the first difference.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EAFC
name: return_signed_compare_result
description: Returns minus one when the processor flags left by the caller show less-than-or-equal, and one otherwise. No comparison is visible in this fragment.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB08
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the terminating zero of the destination buffer and copies the source string onto its end, then returns the original destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB20
name: copy_bounded_string_padded
description: Copies characters from the source string into the destination up to the given count, stopping at the terminator and zero-filling the rest of the count. It returns the destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB30
name: copy_bounded_string_tail
description: A gap fragment of the bounded copy: it copies the source bytes up to the terminator, then zero-fills the remaining count.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB3A
name: zero_fill_bytes
description: Writes zero to a run of bytes starting at the pointer, using the count as the loop bound.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB44
name: check_char_class_table
description: A gap fragment of the character-class scan: it checks the string's first byte against a class bit and calls a called routine. The returned value comes from an unassigned local, so the result is unreliable as decoded.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB78
name: notify_handler_list_then_call
description: Walks the handler list in the context, calling each one, then passes its argument to a finishing called routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EB7C
name: notify_handler_list_then_call
description: Walks the handler list in the context, calling each one, then calls a finishing called routine with no arguments.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EBC6
name: unwind_queue_free_nodes
description: Restores several fields from its argument block and, while the queue in the context is non-empty, pops nodes and frees each with exec.FreeMem. It calls a library routine at offset minus 732 when a 16-bit field is above 35, then returns the final value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:c/lzx:0:EC50
name: wrap_helper_call
description: Calls a single called routine with no arguments and returns, acting as a thin wrapper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:0236
name: setup_arp_record_block
description: Part of the arp.library shared library: it reads entries through a library call and, when the walk completes, fills in a structure and allocates a block for it. Otherwise it runs a cleanup library call and returns.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:0266
name: read_arp_records_then_setup
description: Part of the arp.library shared library: it reads a counted list of records through a library call, and when the count runs out it runs the same setup and allocation sequence as the record setup routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:029E
name: finish_arp_record_setup
description: Part of the arp.library shared library: it fills in a structure from the record, allocates a block through a library call and links it in, or runs a cleanup library call and returns when the allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:02F0
name: increment_arp_counter_loop
description: Part of the arp.library shared library, a gap fragment: it repeatedly calls a called routine and a library routine at offset minus 462 until a flag is set, then increments a 16-bit counter at offset 32.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:0302
name: clear_field_call_library
description: Part of the arp.library shared library, a gap fragment: it clears a 32-bit field at offset 8 of the structure in the address register and calls a library routine through a base pointer stored in the structure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:libs/arp.library:0:046E
name: allocate_sized_block_header
description: Part of the arp.library shared library: when the size is non-zero it allocates a block with the exec.AllocMem library routine and, if the allocation succeeds, stores the size plus four at the start of the block.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:0000
name: run_program_startup
description: Program entry point that allocates a block, copies 816 longwords of initial data into it and adds the block base to each entry of a relocation list. It then opens libraries, reads the current directory and waits on a message port.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:020C
name: shutdown_and_return_value
description: Saves the value passed in into the frame, runs an optional callback, then calls a sequence of library routines to release resources before returning the saved value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:02A8
name: forward_call_via_pointer
description: Forwards the global argument to a routine reached through an indirect pointer kept in the data area, then returns nothing. It is a single-call trampoline.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:02AE
name: forward_call_return_code
description: Calls the same indirect pointer with the global argument and then returns the constant 20 as its result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:02B4
name: tokenise_command_line
description: Splits a text line into whitespace-separated words, treating double-quoted runs as single words and star sequences as escapes for escape, newline or a literal character. It stores the words in a newly allocated pointer array, then calls each handler in a stored linked list.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:02BC
name: run_probe_and_flag_failure
description: Runs an initial called routine, then a probe routine on a context sub-block and a global buffer. A zero probe result sets the failure flag byte in the context, while a non-zero result runs two more called routines and the function returns true.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:02FA
name: mark_context_failed
description: Sets the failure flag byte in the context block to one and returns zero. It is reached through a pointer stored in the data area, so it works as an error handler.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:0818
name: write_block_update_total
description: Returns one at once when the failure flag is clear and a status routine returns non-zero. Otherwise it writes the buffer through a called routine and adds the requested length to the running total in the context when every byte was written, returning zero; a short write returns two.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:0836
name: verify_write_adds_total
description: Calls a write routine on the context block and compares its result with the length held in a data register. On a full match it adds that length to the running total and returns zero; otherwise it returns two.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:084E
name: add_count_to_total
description: Adds the length in a data register to the running total stored in the context block and returns zero. It is a one-line accumulator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:142E
name: free_linked_node_list
description: Walks the singly linked list whose head sits in the context block, calling a called routine on each node with the fixed size 118. Afterwards it clears the head pointer and node count and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:144C
name: reset_node_list_head
description: Sets the list head pointer and the node count in the context block to zero, emptying the list without visiting its nodes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:162C
name: pack_context_flags_byte
description: Packs eight flag bytes from the context block into one output byte, one flag per bit, and stores it through the caller's pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:51C8
name: parse_command_switches
description: Parses the argument words of the command, each a dash-prefixed switch letter with an optional attached value. A large switch stores flags and values in the context and clamps numeric settings to fixed minimum and maximum bounds, and an unrecognised letter reports an error and returns one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5B7C
name: next_option_value
description: Walks the argument vector past words that do not start with a dash, records the index of the first option seen, and returns the text attached after the switch letter, or an empty string when nothing is attached. It returns null once the arguments run out.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5B82
name: next_option_value
description: Walks the argument vector past words that do not start with a dash, records the index of the first option seen, and returns the text attached after the switch letter, or an empty string when nothing is attached. It returns null once the arguments run out.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5C24
name: next_positional_argument
description: Returns the next argument that is not a dash-prefixed switch, skipping switches on the way. After a double-dash argument, dash-prefixed words are also returned as arguments, and null is returned when the list is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5C8E
name: parse_slash_date_fields
description: Parses a slash-separated year, month and day string. The year must be from 1970 to 2099, the month from 1 to 12 and the day from 1 to 31, and the year's low byte is stored offset by the letter N with the month and day in the output buffer; it returns one when any field is out of range.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5CBA
name: store_year_parse_month_day
description: Fragment of the date parser entered after the year is known: it stores the year byte, then parses the month and day fields after the slash separators with the same range checks of 12 and 31. It returns zero on success and one on a bad field.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5CD2
name: parse_month_day_fields
description: Parses the month and then the day from the remaining string, after an optional leading slash, with ranges one to 12 and one to 31. The values go to the output at offsets two and one, and the routine returns zero when both are valid.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)[h dlm](disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)[h DLM](Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:lzx:0:5CE4
name: parse_month_then_day
description: Parses a month number from the start of the remaining string, then skips to the next slash and parses a day number, checking the ranges one to 12 and one to 31. It returns zero when both are valid.
